note: Pages whose text overlaps heavily (5-word shingles; similarity = shared / all, contained = shared / smaller page), reviewed by hand. Redirect stubs are left out.

groups.title: Jim Gray Doctoral Dissertation Award: process pages
groups.why: Three pages describe the same nomination process (2015 and 2017 versions, 65–79% the same text), next to the award page itself.
groups.suggestion: Keep /sigmod-awards/sigmod-jim-gray-doctoral-dissertation-award/ with a 'Process' section and the current call. Redirect the 2015 and 2017 process pages to it.

groups.title: Calls for nominations, copied every year
groups.why: The 2016–2022 calls repeat 60–94% of the same text. They are dated announcements, so they are not wrong, but a reader can land on an old call.
groups.suggestion: Keep them as dated news, and add a line at the top of each pointing to the current call on /sigmod-awards/. Or redirect the older ones to /sigmod-awards/.

groups.title: Yearly award announcements repeat the award pages
groups.why: The yearly news post quotes the citation that is also on the award page. This is by design.

groups.title: Samuel Madden's biography on two award pages
groups.why: His 2016 Contributions Award page and the 2017 Test of Time page (he is a co-author) carry the same biography.

groups.title: Same title, different pages
groups.why: The 2004 and 2006 Test of Time pages with a '-2' address are a second winning paper in the same year. The two 'Committees' pages are SIGMOD's committees and the (empty) awards-committees parent page.
groups.suggestion: No change. The empty /sigmod-awards/committees/ page could link to the award committee pages.

groups.title: SIGMOD Anthology
groups.why: /publications/anthology/ and /publications/anthologyhome/ had the same content (87% of the text). anthologyhome had the newer links (2019); anthology had the paragraph on the editors.
groups.suggestion: Done: /publications/anthology/ has the 2019 content plus the editors paragraph; /publications/anthologyhome/ redirects to it.
